I'm checking the SVG's viewBox dimensions to confirm it's square, then examining the path data with its transform to understand the shape's actual bounding box within that space.

Working through the coordinate math: applying the scale-then-translate transform to the path's original x and y ranges gives a bounding box of roughly x:[112.9,190.6], y:[127.4,238]. Then I compute the circle's bounding box from its center and radius, getting x:[186.1,213.9], to see how it overlaps with the path.

Combining both boxes, I get an overall content region of about 112.9 to 213.9 in x (width ~101) and 127.4 to 239.4 in y (height ~112). Comparing this to the current viewBox center, the content center sits noticeably left of the viewBox's center, so I need to adjust the viewBox to properly recenter around the actual content.

Given the current padding is uneven (4 on the left vs 18.3 on the right, 6.3 on top), I want to build a new square viewBox that keeps roughly the same total padding amount but distributes it evenly on all sides so the characters sit centered.

I'll go with a square viewBox where padding equals (S - content_width)/2 horizontally and (S - content_height)/2 vertically, so the content stays centered regardless of its non-square aspect ratio.

Actually I realize the original viewBox is already 123.284x123.284 — already square. So the real problem isn't the viewBox shape but that the content itself isn't centered within it.

Transparency is already handled since there's no background rect. So really all I need to do is recompute the viewBox origin so the content's center aligns with the square's center, keeping the same overall dimensions and preserving the padding feel.

Combining the x ranges, the circle extends further than the path, giving overall x from 112.948 to 213.9, centered at 163.424. Doing the same for y, the path spans down to 238 while the circle reaches 239.4, giving a combined range of 127.396 to 239.4, centered at 183.398 -- so the overall content center lands at (163.424, 183.398).

Using half the square dimension (61.642) from that center, I get a new viewBox starting at (101.782, 121.756) with size 123.284x123.284. Checking the padding on all sides confirms it's symmetric -- 11.166 on left and right, 5.64 on top and bottom -- so this keeps the square size while centering everything properly.

Now I'll update the icon.svg file with this new viewBox, keeping the existing width/height attributes and leaving the background transparent.

data.content: The viewBox is already square (123.284×123.284) and there's no background rect, so it's transparent by default. The actual issue is the content isn't centered — the "P" path and dot bounding box sits off-center within the viewBox. I recomputed the combined bounding box and re-centered the same-size viewBox around it, keeping equal padding on all sides.
